author: Alpp
body:
I was playing on an alt I got for my birthday a week ago and wanted to go play on avicus after have being banned for nearly a year on my main account . I was playing for the second or third time on my alt playing legally and not breaking any rules and then I was banned for ban evasion.

Please may I be unbanned on Alpixel ( alt ) and PvpForTheGods ( main ) because I have not hacked in over a year after  I saw that it was getting me banned from many servers. I do understand that I was in the wrong for using my hacks and for ruining the gameplay of other players who were trying to play without being disturbed ith any of the hacks business. I would really find it appreciated if I could be unbanned because avicus is really a very good server which i like to play with some friends and I was really happy when I got my alt for then I could play avicus again. However I was caught ban evading and was banned. Please make my dream come true. If i am caught hacking again ban me and neverunban me but please just this once can i be given another chance?

title: Please Can I Get Un-banned

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
You decided to use Alpixel while you were banned on PvpForTheGods and now you have to face the consequences. Try to appeal in 3-5 months if you wish to get appealed. I will have this appeal open for 24 hours incase you have something to say. This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Jiveh
